name: Windows Update Restart Guard
changes_cs: Prebuildovano proti aktualnimu WDUi default skin packu s novym skinem Neon Rose Black; instalator a runtime payload RG ted nesou aktualni sadu WDUi skinu.
changes_en: Rebuilt against the current WDUi default skin pack with the new Neon Rose Black skin; the RG installer and runtime payload now carry the current WDUi skin set.

history.changes_cs: Prebuildovano proti aktualnimu WDUi default skin packu s novym skinem Neon Rose Black; instalator a runtime payload RG ted nesou aktualni sadu WDUi skinu.
history.changes_en: Rebuilt against the current WDUi default skin pack with the new Neon Rose Black skin; the RG installer and runtime payload now carry the current WDUi skin set.

history.changes_cs: Do zahlavi nastaveni byl doplnen viditelny retezec verze hned za nazvem aplikace: Windows Update Restart Guard - v1.0.139 - Nastaveni.
history.changes_en: Added the visible version string to the settings titlebar immediately after the app name: Windows Update Restart Guard - v1.0.139 - Settings.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno svisle orezani casovych poli Od/Do v nastaveni restartovacich oken; edit boxy a stepper sipky se prizpusobi vysce aktualniho WDUi skinu.
history.changes_en: Fixed vertical clipping in the From/To time fields in restart-window settings; edit boxes and stepper arrows now adapt to the current WDUi skin height.

history.changes_cs: Časová pole Od/Do v nastavení restartovacích oken mají větší dvouciferné segmenty a layout editoru jim rezervuje dost místa i v širších WDUi skinech, takže hodnoty jako 13:00 a 17:00 už nejsou uříznuté.
history.changes_en: The From/To time fields in restart-window settings now use wider two-digit segments and the editor reserves enough room even in wider WDUi skins, so values like 13:00 and 17:00 are no longer clipped.

history.changes_cs: Nastavení se teď při větším okně roztahuje vyváženě: horní panely i panel restartovacích oken využijí šířku a výšku okna a spodní řádek má kratší esteticky vyvážený výběr skinu.
history.changes_en: Settings now scale more evenly in larger windows: the top panels and restart-window panel use the window width and height, and the bottom row keeps the skin selector shorter and visually balanced.

history.changes_cs: Tray tooltip nad ikonou teď ukazuje plný název aplikace, aktuální stav ochrany a používá NIF_SHOWTIP, aby Windows zobrazil smysluplné informace.
history.changes_en: The tray hover tooltip now shows the full app name, current guard status, and uses NIF_SHOWTIP so Windows displays meaningful information.

history.changes_cs: Vychozi velikost nastaveni se pocita jako dve tretiny aktualniho desktopu a reset velikosti vraci okno na stejnou dynamickou velikost.
history.changes_en: The settings default size is now computed as two thirds of the current desktop and size reset returns the window to that dynamic size.

history.changes_cs: Znormalizovana update ikona v zahlavi nastaveni: static base art plus WDUi tint overlay, vychozi velikost nastaveni 900x700 a reset velikosti v zahlavi.
history.changes_en: Normalized the settings titlebar update icon with static base art plus WDUi tint overlay, default settings size 900x700, and titlebar size reset.

history.changes_cs: Znovu znormalizovano proti aktualnimu durable WDUi/RG baseline: source VERSION je opet srovnana s verejnym ADPU kanalem, settings/tray/setup skeleton obsahuje posledni RG normalizace vcetne UI vykonu, hlavicky, tray togglu a build/smoke optimalizaci.
history.changes_en: Renormalized against the current durable WDUi/RG baseline: the source VERSION is aligned with the public ADPU channel again, and the settings/tray/setup skeleton includes the latest Restart Guard normalization for UI performance, titlebar, tray toggles, and build/smoke optimization.

history.changes_cs: WDUi zrychluje Direct2D partial repaint: native batch ma dirty-rect clip a GDI interop DC pouziva CLEAR misto COPY. Partial repaint uz nema tahat full-scene text/bitmap paint.
history.changes_en: WDUi speeds up Direct2D partial repaint: the native batch has a dirty-rect clip and the GDI interop DC uses CLEAR instead of COPY. Partial repaint should no longer pull full-scene text/bitmap paint.

history.changes_cs: WDUi zrychluje Direct2D paint batching: drawSurface uz neukoncuje native batch pred kazdym surface a GDI fallbacky flushuji az pred skutecnym GDI kreslenim. Render smoke hlida nizky batch count.
history.changes_en: WDUi speeds up Direct2D paint batching: drawSurface no longer ends the native batch before every surface and GDI fallbacks flush only before real GDI drawing. The render smoke now guards a low batch count.

history.changes_cs: WDUi zrychluje SelectableTextBlock pro dlouhe texty: paint a pointer hit-test pouzivaji viditelny line range misto skenovani celeho dokumentu. Restart Guard build zachovava --render-diagnostics smoke pro Direct2D backend.
history.changes_en: WDUi speeds up SelectableTextBlock for long text: painting and pointer hit-testing use the visible line range instead of scanning the whole document. This Restart Guard build keeps the --render-diagnostics smoke for the Direct2D backend.

history.changes_cs: Restart Guard ma novy --render-diagnostics rezim pro rychle overeni WDUi backendu: settings okno provede kratky paint pass, zapise effective Direct2D/DirectWrite metriky do logu a smoke wrapper je kontroluje. Soucasti buildu zustava WDUi RichTextBlock DirectWrite optimalizace.
history.changes_en: Restart Guard adds a new --render-diagnostics mode for quick WDUi backend verification: the settings window performs a short paint pass, logs effective Direct2D/DirectWrite metrics, and the smoke wrapper checks them. The build still includes the WDUi RichTextBlock DirectWrite optimization.

history.changes_cs: WDUi posouva RichTextBlock text paint do DirectWrite fast pathu pri aktivnim Direct2D backendu; GDI fallback zustava kompatibilni. Build obsahuje rozsireny render-backend smoke pro rich text.
history.changes_en: WDUi moves RichTextBlock text painting onto the DirectWrite fast path when the Direct2D backend is active; the GDI fallback remains compatible. The build includes expanded rich-text render-backend smoke coverage.

history.changes_cs: WDUi zrychluje RichTextBlock: stabilni rich text cacheuje segment layout a link hit rects, takze se pri opakovanem paintu znovu nepremeruje. Build obsahuje novou richTextMeasureCount diagnostiku.
history.changes_en: WDUi speeds up RichTextBlock: stable rich text caches segment layout and link hit rects, so repeated paints no longer remeasure segments. The build includes the new richTextMeasureCount diagnostics.

history.changes_cs: WDUi zrychluje layout dlouhych SelectableTextBlock textu: word-wrap uz nepremeruje prefix widths pro kazdy zalomeny radek a RG build nese nove textPrefixMeasureCount diagnostiky.
history.changes_en: WDUi speeds up long SelectableTextBlock layout: word wrapping no longer remeasures prefix widths for every visual line and the RG build includes the new textPrefixMeasureCount diagnostics.

history.changes_cs: WDUi zrychluje layout dlouhych SelectableTextBlock textu: word-wrap uz nepremeruje prefix widths pro kazdy zalomeny radek a RG build nese nove textPrefixMeasureCount diagnostiky.
history.changes_en: WDUi speeds up long SelectableTextBlock layout: word wrapping no longer remeasures prefix widths for every visual line and the RG build includes the new textPrefixMeasureCount diagnostics.

history.changes_cs: WDUi Direct2D backend snizuje latenci kresleni: native surface, text, PBGRA a image bitmap helpery se davkuji uvnitr GDI interop scope a RG loguje d2d_native_batches pro kontrolu batchingu.
history.changes_en: WDUi Direct2D backend reduces rendering latency: native surface, text, PBGRA, and image bitmap helpers are batched inside the GDI interop scope, and RG logs d2d_native_batches for batching diagnostics.

history.changes_cs: WDUi Direct2D backend ted sklada skin, ikony a bitmap controls pres nativni cache bitmap misto GDI AlphaBlend fallbacku; diagnostika loguje image bitmap paint/create pocty.
history.changes_en: WDUi Direct2D backend now composes skin, icon, and bitmap-control images through a native cached bitmap path instead of the GDI AlphaBlend fallback; diagnostics log image bitmap paint/create counts.

history.changes_cs: WDUi Direct2D backend ted sklada skin, ikony a bitmap controls pres nativni cache bitmap misto GDI AlphaBlend fallbacku; diagnostika loguje image bitmap paint/create pocty.
history.changes_en: WDUi Direct2D backend now composes skin, icon, and bitmap-control images through a native cached bitmap path instead of the GDI AlphaBlend fallback; diagnostics log image bitmap paint/create counts.

history.changes_cs: WDUi Direct2D sklada cached material/PBGRA vrstvy pres nativni ID2D1Bitmap a RG loguje nove d2d_pbgra_* citace.
history.changes_en: WDUi Direct2D now composites cached material/PBGRA layers through native ID2D1Bitmap and RG logs the new d2d_pbgra_* counters.

history.changes_cs: WDUi Direct2D sklada cached material/PBGRA vrstvy pres nativni ID2D1Bitmap a RG loguje nove d2d_pbgra_* citace.
history.changes_en: WDUi Direct2D now composites cached material/PBGRA layers through native ID2D1Bitmap and RG logs the new d2d_pbgra_* counters.

history.changes_cs: WDUi Direct2D snizuje resource churn: opakovane solid brushe pro text, fill, border a rim se sdileji v jednom paint passu a render diagnostika loguje create/reuse pocty.
history.changes_en: WDUi Direct2D reduces resource churn: repeated solid brushes for text, fill, border, and rim are shared within one paint pass, and render diagnostics logs create/reuse counts.

history.changes_cs: WDUi render diagnostika vypisuje i DirectWrite text pass a build linkuje novy DirectWrite fast path.
history.changes_en: WDUi render diagnostics now include the DirectWrite text pass and the build links the new DirectWrite fast path.

history.changes_en: The factual changelog for this historical version was not preserved in the available archive. No specific feature is claimed; the record only identifies a verified technical update publication.

history.changes_cs: Zrychleni WDUi/RG resize: Direct2D render target se pri zmene velikosti jen resizeuje misto zbytecneho zahazovani a WDUi behem ziveho resize docasne omezi drahe materialove/spatial efekty. Nastaveni take zapisuje render diagnostiku do logu.
history.changes_en: WDUi/RG resize performance fix: Direct2D render targets are resized instead of recreated on every size change, and WDUi temporarily limits expensive material/spatial effects during live resizing. Settings also logs render diagnostics.

history.changes_cs: Prebuildovano proti nejnovějšímu WDUi baseline se spatial material skin catalogem. Viditelne chovani Restart Guardu se nemeni; release jen srovnava appku s aktualnim WDUi.
history.changes_en: Rebuilt against the latest WDUi baseline with the spatial material skin catalog. Restart Guard behavior is intentionally unchanged; this release realigns the app with current WDUi.

history.changes_cs: Opravena funkcnost vlastniho zahlavi nastaveni: posun okna a tlacitka minimalizovat, maximalizovat/obnovit a zavrit znovu provadeji akce. Pridana volba Vykon UI s rezimy Vyvazeny, Max detaily a Max vykon.
history.changes_en: Fixed the custom settings titlebar: moving the window and minimize, maximize/restore, and close buttons now perform their actions again. Added a UI performance setting with Balanced, Max details, and Max performance modes.

history.changes_cs: Opravena funkcnost vlastniho zahlavi nastaveni: posun okna a tlacitka minimalizovat, maximalizovat/obnovit a zavrit znovu provadeji akce. Pridana volba Vykon UI s rezimy Vyvazeny, Max detaily a Max vykon.
history.changes_en: Fixed the custom settings titlebar: moving the window and minimize, maximize/restore, and close buttons now perform their actions again. Added a UI performance setting with Balanced, Max details, and Max performance modes.

history.changes_en: Fixed the custom settings titlebar: moving the window and minimize, maximize/restore, and close buttons now perform their actions again. Added a UI performance setting with Balanced, Max details, and Max performance modes.

history.changes_en: Fixed the custom settings titlebar: moving the window and minimize, maximize/restore, and close buttons now perform their actions again.

history.changes_cs: Přebuildováno proti aktuálnímu WDUi: aplikace teď dědí výchozí RenderBackend::Auto, preferuje Direct2D/GPU renderer a má GDI fallback.
history.changes_en: Rebuilt against current WDUi: the app now inherits the default RenderBackend::Auto path, preferring the Direct2D/GPU renderer with GDI fallback.

history.changes_cs: Hlavni okno Nastaveni zobrazuje tooltipy az po delsim najeti; release build preskakuje nezmenenou WDUi knihovnu i zbytecne lokalizacni seed generovani podle obsahovych fingerprintu.
history.changes_en: The Settings window now waits longer before showing tooltips; release builds skip unchanged WDUi library compilation and unnecessary localization seed generation through content fingerprints.

history.changes_cs: Hlavni okno Nastaveni zobrazuje tooltipy az po delsim najeti a release build preskakuje nezmenenou WDUi knihovnu podle hash fingerprintu.
history.changes_en: The Settings window now waits longer before showing tooltips, and release builds skip unchanged WDUi library compilation through a hash fingerprint.

history.changes_cs: Vychozi motiv Restart Guardu je Windows 11 Auto, ktery sleduje svetly/tmavy rezim Windows.
history.changes_en: Restart Guard now defaults to Windows 11 Auto, following the Windows light/dark app mode.

history.changes_cs: Restart Guard pridava systemovou politiku Windows Update: automaticke stahovani zustava zapnute, ale instalace a restarty jsou rizene pres UI; setup/repair selze, pokud politiku nejde zapsat.
history.changes_en: Restart Guard adds a Windows Update policy layer: automatic downloads remain enabled, but install/restart flow stays UI-driven; setup/repair now fails if the policy cannot be written.

history.changes_cs: Sjednoceno tray chovani: handler overuje ID tray ikony z HIWORD(lParam) a zachovava spravne primarni/kontextove akce.
history.changes_en: Normalized tray behavior: the handler now validates the tray icon id from HIWORD(lParam) while preserving primary and context actions.

history.changes_cs: Sjednoceno tray chovani: handler overuje ID tray ikony z HIWORD(lParam) a zachovava spravne primarni/kontextove akce.
history.changes_en: Normalized tray behavior: the handler now validates the tray icon id from HIWORD(lParam) while preserving primary and context actions.
